notes: City id melbourne is a SEPARATE city. Do not invent city=mel, city=ptv, city=vic, or city=us. Do not merge V/Line long-distance or Yarra Trams into this city id. Agency Metro Trains Melbourne (PTV/Transport Victoria). Modes v1: Metro Trains suburban rail only (PTV route_type = 0 equivalent / GTFS folder 2 Metropolitan Train). No Yarra Trams, no buses (incl. Night Bus), no SkyBus, no V/Line long-distance beyond the walk-up services carried in docs/melbourne-d1/open-data-feed-and-eligibility.md, no coaches, no interstate, no Melbourne Airport Rail / Suburban Rail Loop (not yet printed as open on the official train map).

ENVIRONMENT LIMITATION (flagged, not guessed past): this pack was produced without a browser/PDF-fetch tool, so the official train-map PDF bytes were not directly re-rendered in this lane either (same Cloudflare block the oracle report hit). Station order and grouping below are a hand-transcription from established, well-documented knowledge of the current Metro Trains network plus the oracle report's verified line-group names and Metro Tunnel routing. Before any flip, Jim or Mark must diff this stations[] list against a fresh fetch of the official PDF page-by-page; do not treat this JSON as verified-by-image the way Washington/Boston's crop screenshots were.
Timezone Australia/Melbourne HAS DST (AEDT/AEST). Do not copy Perth/Brisbane/Adelaide no-DST assumptions.

Hub lock: Flinders Street. It is the inner lock for the City Loop / cross-city surface groups (Sandringham direct; Frankston, Glen Waverley, Alamein, Belgrave, Lilydale, Hurstbridge, Mernda, Craigieburn, Upfield, Werribee, Williamstown, Racecourse via the loop or direct). Flinders Street is NOT on the Sunbury/Cranbourne/Pakenham Metro Tunnel spine — those three lines skip Flinders Street, North Melbourne, and the City Loop entirely after 1 Feb 2026 (see metroTunnel below). Existing dogfood catalog/probe conventions that use Flinders Street as the example stop are respected; do not contradict that lock for the non-tunnel line groups.

City Loop stations (Flagstaff, Melbourne Central, Parliament) plus the two surface hub buildings (Flinders Street, Southern Cross) are the shared inner set for the loop-serving line groups. Melbourne Central is City Loop only (not the tunnel). Parliament serves the Frankston/Sandringham-direction loop portal plus the Burnley-group loop portal, not every group. Town Hall is Metro Tunnel only (not the City Loop) and is a DIFFERENT building from Flinders Street, linked only by the surface Degraves Street Subway. State Library is Metro Tunnel only and is a DIFFERENT building from Melbourne Central, linked only by an underground concourse. See direction-model-memo.md for which lines use the loop vs run direct by time of day -- this file records the station graph, not the schedule pattern.

Southern Cross is shared by Metro Trains (all loop/direct groups except Sandringham/Frankston-when-direct) AND V/Line long-distance. Same physical building, doNotGroup by mode in hazard-pack (Southern Cross Metro vs Southern Cross V/Line) so a V/Line-only walk-up service is never silently dropped nor double counted against the Metro board.
Stony Point IS IN as a Metro line (Frankston-Stony Point diesel shuttle), confirmed by the official PTV route page and the Metro Trains line picker -- not V/Line.

Racecourse line (Flemington Racecourse, Showgrounds) is IN as printed Metro special-events stations, not a daily all-day spine. They run for race days / shows only. Kept on the map per the 'dashed special-events print' convention -- do not timetable them as regular weekday Metro service.

17 named line groups on the current Metro Trains picker: Alamein, Belgrave, Craigieburn, Cranbourne, Frankston, Glen Waverley, Hurstbridge, Lilydale, Mernda, Pakenham, Racecourse, Sandringham, Stony Point, Sunbury, Upfield, Werribee, Williamstown. 16 run as regular all-day service; Racecourse is special-events only.

Metro Tunnel through-running (passenger from 1 Feb 2026): Sunbury + Cranbourne + Pakenham now form one continuous corridor through Arden, Parkville, State Library, Town Hall, Anzac, bypassing Flinders Street / North Melbourne / the City Loop. See metroTunnel block below.

Board-eligibility verdicts for V/Line services calling at shared Metro stations (Southern Cross, Flinders Street, Richmond, Caulfield, Clayton, Dandenong, Pakenham, North Melbourne, Footscray, Sunshine, Broadmeadows) live in docs/melbourne-d1/open-data-feed-and-eligibility.md and are carried into hazard-pack.md. The Maryborough rows at Footscray and Sunshine are `undecided` and must be resolved before any flip.

This JSON does not carry stopIds -- Jim resolves GTFS stop_id / parent_station values against the static feed in folder 2 (Metropolitan Train) of the nested statewide zip, matched by name/alias, never by inventing IDs here.

printedInnerCityNames.lockNote: Locked inner hub for the City Loop / surface cross-city groups (all groups except Sunbury/Cranbourne/Pakenham post-tunnel). Existing dogfood catalog and probe already use Flinders Street as the example stop -- do not contradict.
printedInnerCityNames.doNotCollapseNote: Federation Square is NOT a station -- it is Town Hall's Swanston Street / Young & Jackson walk-up entrance, kept in this list only as a hazard reminder, not as a stations[] entry. 'Union' is carried from the oracle report's doNotGroup line ('Union (Pakenham/Cranbourne suburban, not Sydney)') but could not be independently confirmed against a current Metro Trains station list in this lane -- flagged as an open item in hazard-pack.md rather than inserted into any line's stations[] without verification.

cityLoop.note: Every loop-serving group runs via the loop for part of the timetable and direct (skipping Flagstaff/Melbourne Central/Parliament, calling only Flinders Street/Southern Cross) for the rest, reversing by time of day and by which portal that group is rostered to. See direction-model-memo.md -- this is the hardest hazard in the pack and needs Tim's copy decision on whether 'via City Loop' surfaces in the UI.

metroTunnel.note: Sunbury (west) through-runs with Cranbourne and Pakenham (south-east) via the new twin tunnels, joining at Footscray on the west side and South Yarra on the east side. These three lines do NOT call Flinders Street, North Melbourne, or the City Loop. Town Hall interchanges to Flinders Street via the surface Degraves Street Subway; State Library interchanges to Melbourne Central via an underground concourse. No single hub-lock stop string exists on this spine -- see direction-model-memo.md.

coverageGaps: Buses, including Night Bus (separate PTV route_type equivalent). Out of v1.

V/Line long-distance beyond the walk-up services carried `in` per docs/melbourne-d1/open-data-feed-and-eligibility.md (Albury, Swan Hill, Shepparton, Bairnsdale, Warrnambool are `out-reservation`; Maryborough at Footscray/Sunshine is `undecided`).
Coaches, interstate (NSW TrainLink XPT, The Overland). Out of v1, `out-reservation` even where they touch an in-catalog station.
Melbourne Airport Rail / Suburban Rail Loop. Not printed as open on the official train map as of this pack -- do not insert.

Rail-replacement buses, service deviations (skipped stops / changed routes), and platform information are NOT carried by the Open Data Portal's Metro trip-updates feed per the portal's own spec -- recorded as a hazard, not silently assumed present.
Live PDF re-fetch not performed in this lane (no browser/PDF tool available) -- station graph is a hand-transcription pending a page-by-page diff against the live map before flip.

lines.name: Sunbury line

This is the line group the oracle report and hazard-pack flag as skipping the hub lock. Footscray and Sunshine also carry V/Line walk-up services -- see open-data-feed-and-eligibility.md.

lines.name: Pakenham line
